title: Kutná Hora Day Trip from Prague
short_description: The Bone Church and the silver town, close to Prague and easy to fit into a morning or an afternoon. Door to door in your own Mercedes, with your chauffeur waiting and one price for the whole car.
description:
Kutná Hora made its fortune from silver in the Middle Ages and for a time rivalled Prague. What it left behind is on the UNESCO list: the Gothic Cathedral of St Barbara, the Italian Court where the royal mint struck its coins, and in the suburb of Sedlec the ossuary known as the Bone Church.

It is the shortest of our day trips, which makes it the one that fits a spare morning or afternoon. You can leave after breakfast and be back for a late lunch, or go after lunch and return for dinner.

By car you also skip the awkward part of the train journey. The ossuary and the old town are about three kilometres apart, at opposite ends of the town, and your chauffeur can drive you from one to the other during your time there.

Your chauffeur collects you at your address in Prague and drives you to Kutná Hora. The car then waits for the time included in your booking, shown next to the price. You can add extra hours when you book. Time beyond your booking on the day is charged only after a person at Prestigo agrees to it.

The price is for the whole car, not per person. It covers the drive there and back, fuel, motorway tolls and your time in Kutná Hora. You see the total before you pay.

Your chauffeur is a professional driver, not a guide. Entrance tickets, guided tours and meals are not included. If you would like a licensed local guide, book one for the hours you plan to be there and we will help you time the day around it.
highlights: The Sedlec Ossuary, a small chapel decorated with the bones of some 40,000 people
St Barbara’s Cathedral, one of the great Gothic churches of Central Europe
The Italian Court, where the royal mint once struck silver coins
A terrace beside the Jesuit College with a view over the valley
A short drive that fits a morning or an afternoon
A car between the ossuary and the old town, about three kilometres apart

itinerary.title: Pickup at your Prague address
itinerary.body: Your chauffeur meets you at the door of your hotel or apartment in Prague at the time you chose, morning or afternoon.

itinerary.title: Drive east to Kutná Hora
itinerary.body: A short drive on the motorway and local roads takes you out of Prague and into the Bohemian countryside.

itinerary.title: Sedlec Ossuary
itinerary.body: Start with the Bone Church. The chapel is decorated with human bones, including a chandelier and a coat of arms. The visit is short, and photography inside is restricted. Tickets are sold on site.

itinerary.title: To the old town
itinerary.body: Your chauffeur drives you from Sedlec to the historic centre, about three kilometres away, past the Cathedral of the Assumption in Sedlec on the way.

itinerary.title: St Barbara’s Cathedral and lunch
itinerary.body: Visit the cathedral, begun in 1388 and paid for by the miners. Walk the terrace beside the Jesuit College for the view, and find lunch in the old town.

itinerary.title: Back to the car
itinerary.body: Call or message your chauffeur when you are ready. The car is waiting where you were dropped off.

itinerary.title: Return to your Prague address
itinerary.body: The same car and chauffeur bring you back to the same address in Prague where the day began.

includes: A private Mercedes with your own chauffeur, for your party only
Pickup and return at your address in Prague
The drive to Kutná Hora and back, and the short drive between Sedlec and the old town
Waiting time at the destination for the hours included in your booking
Child seats at no charge: tell us the children’s ages when you book
One price for the whole car, shown in full before you pay
excludes: Entrance tickets for the ossuary, the cathedral and other sights
A guide or a guided tour: your chauffeur drives and waits, but is not a guide
Extra hours beyond your booking, unless you add them when you book
pickup_info: Pickup and return are at your address in Prague: a hotel, an apartment or an office. Tell us the exact address when you book. Before the day you receive your chauffeur’s name and phone number, and on the day they wait at the door at the agreed time. Choose a morning or an afternoon start, whichever suits your plans in Prague.
important_info:
The sights are open all year, with shorter hours in winter. Check opening times before you travel.

The ossuary is a place of burial as well as a monument, so dress and behave as you would in a church. Photography inside is restricted.

Sedlec and the old town are about three kilometres apart. Your chauffeur can drive you from one to the other during your time there.

Most visitors see the ossuary first, then the cathedral next to it, and then move to the old town for St Barbara’s and lunch.

Your chauffeur drives and waits, but is not a guide. Entrance tickets and guided tours are not included.

faq.q: How is the price worked out?
faq.a: There is one price for the whole car, set for each car class. It covers the drive there and back, fuel, motorway tolls and the hours at the destination included in your booking. You can add extra hours when you book, and you see the total before you pay.

faq.q: Does the chauffeur wait and drive us back the same day?
faq.a: Yes. The same car and chauffeur take you to Kutná Hora, wait for the time you booked and drive you back to your Prague address. Waiting during the hours in your booking is part of the price.

faq.q: Will the car take us from the Bone Church to the old town?
faq.a: Yes. Sedlec and the old town are about three kilometres apart, and your chauffeur can drive you from one to the other during your time there.

faq.q: What if we want to stay longer on the day?
faq.a: Tell your chauffeur. Time beyond your booking is charged only after a person at Prestigo agrees to it, at the same extra-hour price you saw when you booked. Nothing is charged automatically.

faq.q: Is a guide or an entrance ticket included?
faq.a: No. The price covers the car and the chauffeur. Tickets and guided tours are booked separately, and the chauffeur does not act as a guide. We are glad to help you time the day around a guide or a ticket slot you have booked.

faq.q: How many people fit in one car?
faq.a: Up to three passengers in an E-Class or S-Class and up to six in a V-Class. Larger groups travel in two or more cars. Child seats are free in every class.
